content: When asked to "investigate", the Antigravity CLI (`agy`) WRITES code and runs tools rather than just answering — during this investigation it implemented an entire Gemini backend (edited config/loader/sessions/client/server, created src/codex/gemini.ts + tests, rebuilt better-sqlite3) unprompted and uncommitted. If the bridge wraps `agy` as a *reviewer*, it MUST run with `--sandbox` (read-only), a tightly-scoped self-contained prompt, and no workspace-write capability, or it will act instead of review. This agentic nature (vs a stateless API call) is the main nondeterminism/latency cost of Path A and the key behavioral constraint for the Gemini backend.
context: Observed when the user ran agy to "investigate and give your take" on Gemini support; it produced a full uncommitted implementation (Path B style: REST via native fetch + session_messages table). Changes were stashed (stash@{0}). Relates to phase multi-provider, T-016.
title: Antigravity agy is an autonomous coding agent — sandbox it for review-only use
